lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me that. Your safety comes first right now: if you don’t trust yourself to be alone tonight, call nine one one now. If you can stay on one more call after that, contact Families First at 5-4-1, 3-2-2, 8-7-6-8, then extension one-3 and say you need a safe Place tonight and can’t be by yourself. You’re not making a scene. you’re doing the right thing.
